name: video-player
title: Video Player
description: The parts of a video player around a `<video>` element the project renders: a frame that keeps its shape, controls that step back while it plays, play, mute, volume, time, a scrubber, captions, speed, full screen, and words for loading and failure.

meta.when: Any video a person controls: a clip on a page, a lesson, a recording. The project gives the element its sources (a file, or HLS attached to the element); the parts only drive it, so compose the ones the clip needs. Nothing plays by itself: for a silent, looping decoration use a plain `<video muted loop>` with its own pause control. For sound alone use audio-player; for a picture viewer use lightbox.
meta.example:
<VideoPlayer aria-label="How the kiln is loaded" defaultCaptions>
  <VideoPlayerVideo src="/kiln.mp4" poster="/kiln.jpg">
    <track kind="captions" src="/kiln.en.vtt" srcLang="en" label="English" />
  </VideoPlayerVideo>
  <VideoPlayerLoading />
  <VideoPlayerError />
  <Captions />
  <VideoPlayerControls>
    <VideoPlayerScrubber />
    <VideoPlayerControlsRow>
      <VideoPlayerPlay />
      <VideoPlayerMute />
      <VideoPlayerVolume />
      <VideoPlayerTime />
      <VideoPlayerCaptionsButton className="ms-auto" />
      <VideoPlayerRate />
      <VideoPlayerFullscreen />
    </VideoPlayerControlsRow>
  </VideoPlayerControls>
</VideoPlayer>
